title: SunPath Service Commitments and Roof Work Charges by System Size
content:
SunPath Solar Lease service figures differ by system size in two respects — how quickly a service request is answered and how many panel cleaning visits a lease year includes — while the roof work figures differ only in the removal and reinstall fee.

| Tier | Service request response | Panel cleaning visits included per lease year | Removal and reinstall fee for homeowner roof work | Notice before roof work requiring removal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 5 business days | 0 | $1250.00 | 14 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 5 business days | 0 | $1350.00 | 14 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 5 business days | 0 | $1450.00 | 14 calendar days |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 3 business days | 1 | $1550.00 | 14 calendar days |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 3 business days | 1 | $1650.00 | 14 calendar days |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 2 business days | 2 | $1850.00 | 14 calendar days |

- **Service request response** — the number of business days to respond to a service request.
- **Panel cleaning visits** — the number of panel cleaning visits included per lease year.
- **Removal and reinstall fee** — the fee in US dollars to remove and reinstall the system for homeowner roof work.
- **Notice before roof work** — the number of calendar days of notice the homeowner gives before roof work that requires removal.

### Reading across the sizes

- No panel cleaning visit is included with the SunPath 3.2 kW, SunPath 4.0 kW or SunPath 4.8 kW systems; one per lease year is included with the SunPath 5.6 kW and SunPath 6.4 kW systems, and two with the SunPath 8.0 kW system.
- The response time shortens with size: 5 business days for the three smallest systems, 3 for the SunPath 5.6 kW and SunPath 6.4 kW systems, and 2 for the SunPath 8.0 kW system.
- The 14-day roof work notice is the same for every size.
